mapper.sql: SELECT strategyId, strategyName, strategyType, '' type2, '' type3, '' type4, '' type5, strategyId ||',1' assetTypeId, '' fiterFlag, '' hasChildren, '' batchId, SUM(RATIO*100) ratio FROM (SELECT DISTINCT inv.STRATEGY_ID strategyId, inv.STRATEGY_NAME strategyName, inv.STRATEGY_TYPE strategyType, det.RATIO ,detClass.batch_id FROM PTL_INV_STRATEGY inv LEFT JOIN PTL_INV_STRATEGY_DETAIL det ON inv.STRATEGY_ID = det.STRATEGY_ID LEFT JOIN PTL_INV_STRATEGY_DETAIL_CLASS detClass ON det.BATCH_ID = detClass.BATCH_ID ) GROUP BY strategyId, strategyName, strategyType ORDER BY strategyId, strategyName

SELECT '' strategyId, '' strategyName, '' strategyType,
regexp_replace(LISTAGG( detClass.TYPE_2, ',') WITHIN GROUP (order by (detClass.TYPE_2)) ,'([^,]+)(,\1)*(,|$)','\1\3') type2, regexp_replace(LISTAGG( detClass.TYPE_3, ',') WITHIN GROUP (order by (detClass.TYPE_3)) ,'([^,]+)(,\1)*(,|$)','\1\3') type3, regexp_replace(LISTAGG( detClass.TYPE_4, ',') WITHIN GROUP (order by (detClass.TYPE_4)) ,'([^,]+)(,\1)*(,|$)','\1\3') type4, regexp_replace(LISTAGG( detClass.TYPE_5, ',') WITHIN GROUP (order by (detClass.TYPE_5)) ,'([^,]+)(,\1)*(,|$)','\1\3') type5, inv.STRATEGY_ID||',1,'||detClass.BATCH_ID assetTypeId, #{parentId} pAssetTypeId, '1' fiterFlag, '01' hasChildren, detClass.BATCH_ID batchId, det.RATIO*100 ratio FROM PTL_INV_STRATEGY inv LEFT JOIN PTL_INV_STRATEGY_DETAIL det ON inv.STRATEGY_ID = det.STRATEGY_ID LEFT JOIN PTL_INV_STRATEGY_DETAIL_CLASS detClass ON det.BATCH_ID = detClass.BATCH_ID
GROUP BY detClass.BATCH_ID,inv.STRATEGY_ID,det.RATIO ORDER BY detClass.BATCH_ID
mapper.select: SELECT count(1) from PTL_PORTFOLIO_STGY where STRATEGY_ID = #{strategyId}
mapper.delete: delete from PTL_INV_STRATEGY_DETAIL where STRATEGY_ID = #{strategyId, jdbcType = VARCHAR}
mapper.select: SELECT inv.STRATEGY_ID strategyId, inv.STRATEGY_NAME strategyName, inv.STRATEGY_TYPE strategyType, inv.STRATEGY_DESC strategyDesc, idx.EVAL_INDEX evalIndex, inv.REMARK remark FROM PTL_INV_STRATEGY inv LEFT JOIN PTL_STRATEGY_EVAL_INDEX idx ON inv.STRATEGY_ID = idx.STRATEGY_ID WHERE inv.STRATEGY_ID = #{strategyId, jdbcType = VARCHAR}

SELECT detClass.BATCH_ID batchId,
regexp_replace(LISTAGG( detClass.TYPE_2, ',') WITHIN GROUP (order by (detClass.TYPE_2)) ,'([^,]+)(,\1)*(,|$)','\1\3') type2, regexp_replace(LISTAGG( detClass.TYPE_3, ',') WITHIN GROUP (order by (detClass.TYPE_3)) ,'([^,]+)(,\1)*(,|$)','\1\3') type3, regexp_replace(LISTAGG( detClass.TYPE_4, ',') WITHIN GROUP (order by (detClass.TYPE_4)) ,'([^,]+)(,\1)*(,|$)','\1\3') type4, regexp_replace(LISTAGG( detClass.TYPE_5, ',') WITHIN GROUP (order by (detClass.TYPE_5)) ,'([^,]+)(,\1)*(,|$)','\1\3') type5, det.RATIO*100 ratio FROM PTL_INV_STRATEGY_DETAIL det LEFT JOIN PTL_INV_STRATEGY_DETAIL_CLASS detClass ON det.BATCH_ID = detClass.BATCH_ID WHERE STRATEGY_ID = #{strategyId, jdbcType = VARCHAR} GROUP BY detClass.BATCH_ID, det.RATIO ORDER BY detClass.BATCH_ID ASC
mapper.delete: delete from PTL_STRATEGY_EVAL_INDEX where STRATEGY_ID = #{strategyId, jdbcType = VARCHAR}
mapper.update: update PTL_STRATEGY_EVAL_INDEX set EVAL_INDEX = #{evalIndex} where STRATEGY_ID = #{strategyId}
